import argparse
import os
import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

# Type preparations
df['IMDB_Rating'] = pd.to_numeric(df['IMDB_Rating'], errors='coerce')
df['No_of_Votes'] = pd.to_numeric(df['No_of_Votes'], errors='coerce')
df['Meta_score'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Meta_score'], errors='coerce')
df['Runtime'] = df['Runtime'].astype(str)
if 'Gross' in df.columns:
    df['Gross'] = df['Gross']
else:
    df['Gross'] = pd.Series([np.nan] * len(df))
if 'Certificate' in df.columns:
    df['Certificate'] = df['Certificate']
else:
    df['Certificate'] = pd.Series([np.nan] * len(df))
if 'Genre' in df.columns:
    df['Genre'] = df['Genre'].astype(str)
else:
    df['Genre'] = pd.Series([''] * len(df))

# IMDB_Rating checks before using for normalization and blending
# ASSERTION_START
r = df['IMDB_Rating']
assert r.notna().all()
assert ((r >= 1.0) & (r <= 10.0)).all()
rtimes10 = r * 10
assert np.all(np.isclose(rtimes10, np.round(rtimes10), atol=1e-9))
assert (((r >= 7.0) & (r <= 9.5)).mean() >= 0.90)
# ASSERTION_END

rating_linear = (df['IMDB_Rating'] - 1.0) / 9.0

# No_of_Votes checks before log-scale transformation
# ASSERTION_START
v = df['No_of_Votes']
assert v.notna().all()
assert (v > 0).all()
assert np.all(np.isclose(v, v.astype(np.int64)))
assert ((v >= 10000).mean() >= 0.95)
assert (v <= 3000000).all()
# ASSERTION_END

votes_log = np.log10(df['No_of_Votes'])
votes_scaled = (votes_log - np.log10(10000.0)) / (np.log10(3000000.0) - np.log10(10000.0))
votes_scaled = votes_scaled.clip(0.0, 1.0)

# Meta_score checks before calibration and blending
# ASSERTION_START
m = df['Meta_score']
present_ratio = m.notna().mean()
assert present_ratio >= 0.80 and present_ratio <= 0.90
m_present = m.dropna()
assert ((m_present >= 0) & (m_present <= 100)).all()
assert np.all(np.isclose(m_present, np.round(m_present), atol=1e-9))
# ASSERTION_END

meta_present_mask = df['Meta_score'].notna()
meta_scaled_raw = (df['Meta_score'] / 100.0)

# Cross checks on IMDB_Rating and Meta_score before deriving alignment-sensitive components
# ASSERTION_START
mr = df[['IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score']].dropna()
assert len(mr) >= 2
corr = mr['IMDB_Rating'].corr(mr['Meta_score'])
assert corr > 0.3
diff_ok = (np.abs(mr['IMDB_Rating'] * 10 - mr['Meta_score']) <= 20)
assert diff_ok.mean() >= 0.80
high = mr[mr['IMDB_Rating'] >= 8.5]
if len(high) > 0:
    assert (high['Meta_score'] >= 70).mean() >= 0.70
# ASSERTION_END

# Use rating-based fallback for missing metascore informed by the alignment
meta_scaled = meta_scaled_raw.where(meta_present_mask, df['IMDB_Rating'] / 10.0)

# Runtime checks before using for engagement penalty
# ASSERTION_START
rt = df['Runtime'].astype(str)
pattern = re.compile(r'^\d{2,3} min$')
assert rt.apply(lambda s: pattern.match(s) is not None).all()
assert (rt.str.strip() == rt).all()
mins_series = rt.str.extract(r'^(\d{2,3}) min$', expand=False).astype(int)
assert ((mins_series >= 45) & (mins_series <= 240)).all()
assert (((mins_series >= 75) & (mins_series <= 180)).mean() >= 0.90)
# ASSERTION_END

minutes = df['Runtime'].str.extract(r'^(\d{2,3}) min$', expand=False).astype(int)
runtime_pref_factor = np.where((minutes >= 75) & (minutes <= 180), 1.0, 0.95)

# Gross checks before parsing and using as a tie-break input
# ASSERTION_START
g = df['Gross']
null_ratio = g.isna().mean()
assert null_ratio >= 0.10 and null_ratio <= 0.25
g_present = g.dropna().astype(str)
pat_g = re.compile(r'^[0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})*$')
assert g_present.apply(lambda s: pat_g.match(s) is not None).all()
clean = g_present.str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
vals = pd.to_numeric(clean, errors='coerce')
assert vals.notna().all()
assert ((vals >= 0) & (vals <= 3000000000)).all()
assert (~g_present.str.contains(r'[^\d,]', regex=True)).all()
assert (~g_present.str.contains(r'\.', regex=True)).all()
# ASSERTION_END

gross_usd = pd.to_numeric(df['Gross'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce')
gross_norm = (gross_usd / 3000000000.0)
if gross_norm.notna().any():
    fill_value = float(gross_norm.median(skipna=True))
else:
    fill_value = 0.0
gross_norm = gross_norm.fillna(fill_value).clip(0.0, 1.0)

# Certificate checks before parental control gating
# ASSERTION_START
cert = df['Certificate']
non_null_ratio = cert.notna().mean()
assert non_null_ratio >= 0.85
allowed_cert = set(['U', 'UA', 'A', 'G', 'PG', 'PG-13', 'R', 'NC-17', 'Not Rated', 'Unrated', 'TV-G', 'TV-PG', 'TV-14', 'TV-MA', 'Approved', 'Passed'])
c_nonnull = cert.dropna().astype(str)
assert c_nonnull.isin(list(allowed_cert)).all()
assert (c_nonnull.str.strip() == c_nonnull).all()
assert c_nonnull.str.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$').all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Genre checks before using for parental control gating
# ASSERTION_START
genres = df['Genre'].astype(str)
allowed_tokens = {
    'Action','Adventure','Animation','Biography','Comedy','Crime','Drama','Family','Fantasy','History',
    'Horror','Music','Musical','Mystery','Romance','Sci-Fi','Sport','Thriller','War','Western'
}

def check_genre_tokens(series):
    res_len = []
    res_allowed = []
    res_no_dups = []
    for s in series:
        tokens = [t.strip() for t in s.split(',') if t.strip() != '']
        res_len.append(1 <= len(tokens) <= 3)
        res_allowed.append(all(t in allowed_tokens for t in tokens))
        res_no_dups.append(len(tokens) == len(set(tokens)))
    return pd.Series(res_len, index=series.index), pd.Series(res_allowed, index=series.index), pd.Series(res_no_dups, index=series.index)

len_ok, allowed_ok, no_dups = check_genre_tokens(genres)
assert len_ok.all()
assert allowed_ok.all()
assert no_dups.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Cross checks: Genre + Certificate combinations before gating logic
# ASSERTION_START
g_str = df['Genre'].astype(str)
c_str = df['Certificate'].astype(str)
has_horror = g_str.str.contains(r'\bHorror\b', regex=True)
has_animation_or_family = g_str.str.contains(r'\bAnimation\b|\bFamily\b', regex=True)
has_thriller = g_str.str.contains(r'\bThriller\b', regex=True)
assert (~(has_horror & c_str.isin(['U','G']))).all()
assert (~(has_animation_or_family & c_str.isin(['A','R','NC-17']))).all()
assert (~(c_str.isin(['U','G']) & (has_horror | has_thriller))).all()
assert (~(c_str.isin(['A','R','NC-17']) & g_str.str.contains(r'\bFamily\b', regex=True))).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Composite score construction
meta_weight = np.where(meta_present_mask, 0.30, 0.20)
base_rating_weight = 0.50
votes_weight = 0.20
meta_component = meta_scaled
quality_score = base_rating_weight * rating_linear + votes_weight * votes_scaled + meta_weight * meta_component
quality_score = quality_score * runtime_pref_factor
quality_score = quality_score + 0.02 * gross_norm

ranked = df.copy()
ranked['quality_score'] = quality_score
ranked = ranked.sort_values(['quality_score', 'No_of_Votes'], ascending=[False, False]).reset_index(drop=True)
ranked['rank'] = np.arange(1, len(ranked) + 1)

# Parental controls
kids_cert_ok = ranked['Certificate'].isin(['U', 'G', 'TV-G', 'TV-PG', 'PG'])
kids_genre_ok = ~ranked['Genre'].str.contains(r'\b(Horror|Thriller)\b', regex=True)
ranked['kids_allowed'] = (kids_cert_ok & kids_genre_ok)

teens_cert_ok = ranked['Certificate'].isin(['UA', 'PG-13', 'TV-14', 'PG', 'TV-PG', 'TV-MA']) & ~ranked['Certificate'].isin(['NC-17'])
teens_genre_ok = ~ranked['Genre'].str.contains(r'\bHorror\b', regex=True)
ranked['teens_allowed'] = (teens_cert_ok & teens_genre_ok)

homepage_cols = ['Series_Title','IMDB_Rating','No_of_Votes','Meta_score','Certificate','Genre','Runtime','Gross','quality_score','rank']
for c in homepage_cols:
    if c not in ranked.columns:
        ranked[c] = np.nan

ranked[homepage_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'homepage_ranked.csv'), index=False)
ranked[ranked['kids_allowed']][homepage_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'homepage_ranked_kids.csv'), index=False)
ranked[ranked['teens_allowed']][homepage_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'homepage_ranked_teens.csv'), index=False)

    df['Certificate'] = pd.Series([np.nan] * len(df))
if 'Genre' in df.columns:
    df['Genre'] = df['Genre'].astype(str)
else:
    df['Genre'] = pd.Series([''] * len(df))

# IMDB_Rating checks before using for normalization and blending
# ASSERTION_START
r = df['IMDB_Rating']
assert r.notna().all()
assert ((r >= 1.0) & (r <= 10.0)).all()
rtimes10 = r * 10
assert np.all(np.isclose(rtimes10, np.round(rtimes10), atol=1e-9))
assert (((r >= 7.0) & (r <= 9.5)).mean() >= 0.90)
# ASSERTION_END

rating_linear = (df['IMDB_Rating'] - 1.0) / 9.0

# No_of_Votes checks before log-scale transformation
# ASSERTION_START
v = df['No_of_Votes']
assert v.notna().all()
assert (v > 0).all()
assert np.all(np.isclose(v, v.astype(np.int64)))
assert ((v >= 10000).mean() >= 0.95)
assert (v <= 3000000).all()
# ASSERTION_END

votes_log = np.log10(df['No_of_Votes'])
votes_scaled = (votes_log - np.log10(10000.0)) / (np.log10(3000000.0) - np.log10(10000.0))
votes_scaled = votes_scaled.clip(0.0, 1.0)

# Meta_score checks before calibration and blending
# ASSERTION_START
m = df['Meta_score']
present_ratio = m.notna().mean()
assert present_ratio >= 0.80 and present_ratio <= 0.90
m_present = m.dropna()
assert ((m_present >= 0) & (m_present <= 100)).all()
assert np.all(np.isclose(m_present, np.round(m_present), atol=1e-9))
# ASSERTION_END

meta_present_mask = df['Meta_score'].notna()
meta_scaled_raw = (df['Meta_score'] / 100.0)

# Cross checks on IMDB_Rating and Meta_score before deriving alignment-sensitive components
# ASSERTION_START
mr = df[['IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score']].dropna()
assert len(mr) >= 2
corr = mr['IMDB_Rating'].corr(mr['Meta_score'])
assert corr > 0.3
diff_ok = (np.abs(mr['IMDB_Rating'] * 10 - mr['Meta_score']) <= 20)
assert diff_ok.mean() >= 0.80
high = mr[mr['IMDB_Rating'] >= 8.5]
if len(high) > 0:
    assert (high['Meta_score'] >= 70).mean() >= 0.70
# ASSERTION_END

# Use rating-based fallback for missing metascore informed by the alignment
meta_scaled = meta_scaled_raw.where(meta_present_mask, df['IMDB_Rating'] / 10.0)

# Runtime checks before using for engagement penalty
# ASSERTION_START
rt = df['Runtime'].astype(str)
pattern = re.compile(r'^\d{2,3} min$')
assert rt.apply(lambda s: pattern.match(s) is not None).all()
assert (rt.str.strip() == rt).all()
mins_series = rt.str.extract(r'^(\d{2,3}) min$', expand=False).astype(int)
assert ((mins_series >= 45) & (mins_series <= 240)).all()
assert (((mins_series >= 75) & (mins_series <= 180)).mean() >= 0.90)
# ASSERTION_END

minutes = df['Runtime'].str.extract(r'^(\d{2,3}) min$', expand=False).astype(int)
runtime_pref_factor = np.where((minutes >= 75) & (minutes <= 180), 1.0, 0.95)

# Gross checks before parsing and using as a tie-break input
# ASSERTION_START
g = df['Gross']
null_ratio = g.isna().mean()
assert null_ratio >= 0.10 and null_ratio <= 0.25
g_present = g.dropna().astype(str)
pat_g = re.compile(r'^[0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})*$')
assert g_present.apply(lambda s: pat_g.match(s) is not None).all()
clean = g_present.str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
vals = pd.to_numeric(clean, errors='coerce')
assert vals.notna().all()
assert ((vals >= 0) & (vals <= 3000000000)).all()
assert (~g_present.str.contains(r'[^\d,]', regex=True)).all()
assert (~g_present.str.contains(r'\.', regex=True)).all()
# ASSERTION_END

gross_usd = pd.to_numeric(df['Gross'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce')
gross_norm = (gross_usd / 3000000000.0)
if gross_norm.notna().any():
    fill_value = float(gross_norm.median(skipna=True))
else:
    fill_value = 0.0
gross_norm = gross_norm.fillna(fill_value).clip(0.0, 1.0)

# Certificate checks before parental control gating
# ASSERTION_START
cert = df['Certificate']
non_null_ratio = cert.notna().mean()
assert non_null_ratio >= 0.85
allowed_cert = set(['U', 'UA', 'A', 'G', 'PG', 'PG-13', 'R', 'NC-17', 'Not Rated', 'Unrated', 'TV-G', 'TV-PG', 'TV-14', 'TV-MA', 'Approved', 'Passed'])
c_nonnull = cert.dropna().astype(str)
assert c_nonnull.isin(list(allowed_cert)).all()
assert (c_nonnull.str.strip() == c_nonnull).all()
assert c_nonnull.str.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$').all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Genre checks before using for parental control gating
# ASSERTION_START
genres = df['Genre'].astype(str)
allowed_tokens = {
    'Action','Adventure','Animation','Biography','Comedy','Crime','Drama','Family','Fantasy','History',
    'Horror','Music','Musical','Mystery','Romance','Sci-Fi','Sport','Thriller','War','Western'
}

def check_genre_tokens(series):
    res_len = []
    res_allowed = []
    res_no_dups = []
    for s in series:
        tokens = [t.strip() for t in s.split(',') if t.strip() != '']
        res_len.append(1 <= len(tokens) <= 3)
        res_allowed.append(all(t in allowed_tokens for t in tokens))
        res_no_dups.append(len(tokens) == len(set(tokens)))
    return pd.Series(res_len, index=series.index), pd.Series(res_allowed, index=series.index), pd.Series(res_no_dups, index=series.index)

len_ok, allowed_ok, no_dups = check_genre_tokens(genres)
assert len_ok.all()
assert allowed_ok.all()
assert no_dups.all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Cross checks: Genre + Certificate combinations before gating logic
# ASSERTION_START
g_str = df['Genre'].astype(str)
c_str = df['Certificate'].astype(str)
has_horror = g_str.str.contains(r'\bHorror\b', regex=True)
has_animation_or_family = g_str.str.contains(r'\bAnimation\b|\bFamily\b', regex=True)
has_thriller = g_str.str.contains(r'\bThriller\b', regex=True)
assert (~(has_horror & c_str.isin(['U','G']))).all()
assert (~(has_animation_or_family & c_str.isin(['A','R','NC-17']))).all()
assert (~(c_str.isin(['U','G']) & (has_horror | has_thriller))).all()
assert (~(c_str.isin(['A','R','NC-17']) & g_str.str.contains(r'\bFamily\b', regex=True))).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Composite score construction
meta_weight = np.where(meta_present_mask, 0.30, 0.20)
base_rating_weight = 0.50
votes_weight = 0.20
meta_component = meta_scaled
quality_score = base_rating_weight * rating_linear + votes_weight * votes_scaled + meta_weight * meta_component
quality_score = quality_score * runtime_pref_factor
quality_score = quality_score + 0.02 * gross_norm

ranked = df.copy()
ranked['quality_score'] = quality_score
ranked = ranked.sort_values(['quality_score', 'No_of_Votes'], ascending=[False, False]).reset_index(drop=True)
ranked['rank'] = np.arange(1, len(ranked) + 1)

# Parental controls
kids_cert_ok = ranked['Certificate'].isin(['U', 'G', 'TV-G', 'TV-PG', 'PG'])
kids_genre_ok = ~ranked['Genre'].str.contains(r'\b(Horror|Thriller)\b', regex=True)
ranked['kids_allowed'] = (kids_cert_ok & kids_genre_ok)

teens_cert_ok = ranked['Certificate'].isin(['UA', 'PG-13', 'TV-14', 'PG', 'TV-PG', 'TV-MA']) & ~ranked['Certificate'].isin(['NC-17'])
teens_genre_ok = ~ranked['Genre'].str.contains(r'\bHorror\b', regex=True)
ranked['teens_allowed'] = (teens_cert_ok & teens_genre_ok)

homepage_cols = ['Series_Title','IMDB_Rating','No_of_Votes','Meta_score','Certificate','Genre','Runtime','Gross','quality_score','rank']
for c in homepage_cols:
    if c not in ranked.columns:
        ranked[c] = np.nan

ranked[homepage_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'homepage_ranked.csv'), index=False)
ranked[ranked['kids_allowed']][homepage_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'homepage_ranked_kids.csv'), index=False)
ranked[ranked['teens_allowed']][homepage_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'homepage_ranked_teens.csv'), index=False)
